crossRefs.note: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours…
But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’
Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax…
The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man, and a drunkard; a friend of tax…
Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have…
When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”
When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men, and ate with them!”
I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;
For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated…

translations.web: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
translations.bsb: So the Pharisees and scribes began to grumble: “This man welcomes sinners and eats with them.”
translations.kjv: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.
translations.asv: And both the Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.
